results.name: Pointer pen commits each stroke, ignores another pointer, flushes on switch
Quote anchors survive inserted text and preserve chapter identity
Ambiguous quotes are retained without guessing; context selects a unique duplicate
Two annotation views share additions/deletions and auto-create one source card
EPUB parses all spine chapters, EPUB3 nested TOC, internal links and packaged images
EPUB rejects traversal, oversized declared entries, expansion bombs, DRM, and unsafe URIs
HTML sanitization blocks remote loads, script URLs, inline handlers and CSS
Generic reader ignores old HTML load, loads EPUB, searches across nodes, follows chapter links
Generic reader HTML reload and static Markdown use native renderer adapter
PDF rapid switches destroy stale documents and expose only the latest pages
PDF canvas cache and pixel budgets, zoom cancellation, fold/unfold, close cleanup
PDF recall masks cover whole excerpts, reveal all segments, update notes and delete last annotation
Word switch and explicit reload ignore late conversion and preserve current file
Voice creates audio folder safely, awaits commit before document release, cleans failed mic
Vision OCR merges top-to-bottom lines and repeated words without wrong string lookup
Real PDF.js CropBox projection round-trips at 0/90/180/270 degrees and 30/140/300 percent
PDF cross-page selection persists three page geometries and redraws without duplicating overlays
Real PDF reader aligns selected text and overlays on rotated CropBox pages before and after 300 percent zoom
PDF source jump records history, expands folded pages, matches within 2pt and centers the reference
Legacy rotated PDF annotations retain their old display coordinates without sidecar rewriting
EPUB quote anchors outrank chapter ratios; unresolved or ambiguous quotes only get approximate navigation
PDF recall preserves cross-page reveal, single peek and persistent scope without writing reveal state
HTML recall restores all range segments after render and keeps persistent card state separate
Word and generic document recall buttons update controller state and expose the view-only scope
PDF four layouts preserve shells, group odd final page, persist modes and restore location
PDF paged source jumps/history, focused keyboard steps, limits and spread fit width
PDF tab states restore independent explicit scales and ignore absent or invalid legacy scale
Shared speech continuously queues long text, supports pause/resume, live rate and completion
Speech stop cancels pending sources immediately; owners cannot cancel another reader
All reader speech controls use current document, accept long selections and stop on switch/close
Stylus captures pressure and renders variable width; legacy and mouse ink stay uniform
Pen eraser and lasso intersect sparse segments; moving a group clamps without distorting ink
HTML pen edits persist across split views, undo/redo, lasso move/delete and preserve source IDs
PDF pen edits are page scoped, survive zoom and reload, and empty ink does not block text
All four notebook templates are real renderable PDFs with stable metadata and page coordinates
Notebook creates independent vault files in a study set; template/page updates preserve ink and source cards
Notebook creation form creates and opens the selected paper in the selected study set
Handwriting layers preserve legacy ink/non-ink, switch and overlay one read-only layer, hide reference in recall
Pending handwriting stays on original layer; rename/merge preserve annotation/source identity and permanent default
PDF layers render on the correct pages, persist overlay state, and layer controls survive reopening
Handwriting settings list creates/selects/overlays, same-name merges, deletes non-default ink only after confirmation
Handwriting settings anchors to its tool without dimming, keeps native row order, and stores sync intent without claiming unavailable map handwriting
All reader types expose callable labelled tools and hide internal chrome; PDF native search remains visible
Document notebooks isolate all annotations and handwriting layers, preserve legacy IDs, and source jumps switch notebooks
PDF notebooks isolate folds/bookmarks/layout and keep a pending stroke in its original notebook
Document notebook manager creates/renames and distinguishes clearing current from deleting an inactive notebook
Virtual page collection renders original PDF pages across documents and never writes or embeds source PDF content
Selection/new and append map live excerpts, snapshot other notes, preserve source jumps, and leave source metadata intact
Reference reordering and removal preserve local annotation/source IDs, remap ink and metadata, and never guess removed-page jumps
Reference manifests reject invalid paths/duplicate IDs/missing pages, respect cancellation, and parse ordered page ranges
Page reorganization form creates an openable reference document and its reorder UI persists entry order
PDF outline supports async API, legacy property, named/array/integer destinations and page zero
Public vault PDF rename updates exact msref paths and still renders/jumps without changing source bytes, annotations or reference IDs
Rapid A-B-C PDF moves serialize manifest rewrites, preserve concurrent edits, and leave backup/recovery snapshots unchanged
Three readers expose five real handwriting modes, idempotent notifications, unsubscribe, and off cancels pending placement
Free fluorescent ink persists its brush across tool switch, reopening, and ordinary pen remains opaque
PDF free text places, edits, moves, resizes, creates a source card, and delete/undo/redo retain source identity
Real PDF.js free text stays canonical through CropBox rotations, drag/resize and 300 percent zoom
Image annotations decode a real local File, use their own picker, replace, move/resize and undo without region capture
Asynchronous image loading cannot place into a newly selected layer or document
HTML and Word free overlays use normalized boxes, follow reflow, and do not pollute source quote ranges
Text/image overlays isolate notebooks and ink layers; references stay read-only, merge keeps IDs and layer delete is final
Overlay gestures cancel on Escape or rebuild; stale multi-view undo cannot overwrite another view
PDF page recycling and file release cancel free-overlay pointer listeners before late pointerup
Reference collections snapshot overlays independently and reorder their stable page identity without moving source geometry
All readers expose chronological handwriting/free-overlay undo, ordered redo, immediate state subscriptions and unsubscribe
Legacy independent undo buttons share the same journal and any new family clears every redo branch
Shared history clears across layer/notebook/file changes and stale overlay or ink conflicts invalidate both families
Source cards inherit annotation colors for PDF, Word and HTML excerpts, comments and flashcards
Real PDF uses native browser Worker and leaves window fetch/pdfjsWorker unchanged

environment: isolated Chromium; synthetic files; Obsidian/Mammoth adapters mocked; real bundled PDF.js Worker
